about_short_description.short_description: Encuadrado provides a platform for appointment scheduling, payments, and invoicing.

product.name: Appointment Scheduling Platform
product.description: A platform that allows health professionals to manage their appointment calendars with features like opening/closing schedules, repeating sessions, rescheduling, blocking times, and setting daily session limits.

product.name: Online Payment Processing
product.description: A service that enables health professionals to receive advance or monthly payments online, with automatic reminders sent to patients for pending debts.

product.name: Automatic Electronic Invoicing (Boletas)
product.description: A system that automatically generates electronic invoices for each payment, ensuring compliance with tax authorities without manual intervention.

product.name: Patient Communication and Reminders
product.description: A service that sends automatic appointment reminders and payment notifications to patients via WhatsApp and email.

product.name: Patient Records and Evaluations Management
product.description: A tool for managing patient records, including consultation notes and patient evaluations after sessions.

product.name: Sales and Content Delivery Platform (Vitrina)
product.description: A platform feature that enables health professionals to create and sell courses, ebooks, or workshops to expand their service offerings beyond sessions.
